seoTitle: Paper Trade Bitcoin & Crypto in TradingView's Mobile App
metaDescription: Learn how to enable paper trading in the TradingView mobile app and simulate buying and selling Bitcoin, ETH, and other crypto pairs with virtual funds.
intro: Paper trading lets you practice buying and selling crypto on TradingView without risking real money. This guide walks through enabling the feature in the mobile app, connecting a virtual account, and placing simulated orders on pairs like BTC/USDT so you can build confidence before trading live.

steps.heading: Enable Paper Trading in the Trading Panel
steps.body: Open the TradingView mobile app on Android or iPhone and open the Trading Panel from a chart, then switch the connection to Paper Trading.

steps.heading: Connect your virtual account
steps.body: TradingView links you to a simulated account preloaded with virtual buying power, so no real funds or broker sign-up is needed.

steps.heading: Choose a crypto pair
steps.body: Search for the pair you want to practice with, such as BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT, and open its chart to review price action before placing an order.

steps.heading: Place market, limit, or stop orders
steps.body: Use the order ticket to simulate a buy or sell exactly as you would with a live broker, choosing the order type that fits your strategy.

steps.heading: Monitor positions and P&L
steps.body: Track open positions, profit and loss, and order history from within the app so you can review how each simulated trade played out.

steps.heading: Adjust or reset your balance
steps.body: If you want a clean slate, you can reset your virtual balance and start a new round of practice trades whenever you like.

faq.question: Does paper trading on TradingView use real money?
faq.answer: No, paper trading uses a simulated account with virtual buying power, so no real crypto or cash is at risk.

faq.question: Can I paper trade crypto on both Android and iPhone?
faq.answer: Yes, the paper trading feature works the same way across the Android and iOS TradingView apps.

faq.question: Can I reset my paper trading balance?
faq.answer: Yes, you can reset your virtual account balance from within the paper trading settings to start fresh.

faq.question: What crypto pairs can I practice with?
faq.answer: You can select common pairs like BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, along with other cryptocurrencies available on TradingView's charts.

faq.question: Can I use alerts while paper trading?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView alerts can be used alongside paper trading to help you refine entry and exit points.
